title: Harness部品(計画・Action空間・Context管理)の効果が強さ・Context予算で反転し、旧Model向け構成が新Modelでは無駄になる
summary: arXiv 2609.20804 (2026-09-17) は4 Model・176 matched settings(SWE-Bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.1)でablation。Planningは弱いModelでは精度を支えるが強いModelではCost削減のみで正確性は改善せず、定義済みToolは弱いbash能力のModelに有効だが強いModelはbash-onlyのほうが大幅に低コスト、回復可能なElision機構は複雑さを増すがModelはほぼ使わない。Context管理はwindow予算が厳しいほど効き、主効果はoverflow失敗の防止。

evidence.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
evidence.summary: Ablation of planning/action space/context management across 4 models; benefit depends on model strength and context budget.

notes: Supports D02 (old-model workarounds counterproductive on new models) and P-20260816-66F0FD78 (excess procedure) with controlled quantitative evidence; no new mechanism.
